summary: Line runs through dense bush on a steep slope; no road to stop on.
reasons: Line is in dense bush, not on a road
No tracks or vehicles reach it

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded in thick bush, but the dwelling 14 m from the start and the canoe club 16 m at the far end are close.
drivers.access_and_room: Only the last 20 m or so touches Witton Road at its narrow river-side bend; no pull-off, with a No Stopping Any Time sign there.
drivers.traffic: Quiet bush, with a busy road at the end near the bridge.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on the road at this bend; No Stopping Any Time sign 9 m from the line.

flags: Low-lying: 6 m elevation, Witton Creek 9 m away, flood-prone
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy covers the whole line.
cannot_judge: Whether the line follows a path or stairs
